related_questions.question: How long after testing positive for COVID-19 are you contagious?
related_questions.snippet: You are generally considered infectious from 48 hours before your symptoms started or from testing positive if you have no symptoms. You may still be infectious for as long as you have symptoms, like fever, cough, shortness of breath, runny nose and sore throat. This may last for up to 10 days.

related_questions.question: Can I take a flu test at home?

text_blocks.snippet: Yes, you can take a flu test at home. Several at-home flu tests are available, including those that also test for COVID-19 and RSV. One example is the Pixel by Labcorp test, which is fully FDA-approved and available for individuals ages 2 and older, according to GoodRx. Combination tests that detect both flu and COVID-19 are also an option, offering a convenient way to get a diagnosis faster, according to Emory Healthcare.
